scope: deterministic synthetic file and recovery invariants

trials.invariant: forced replacement failure preserved the baseline bytes and removed the pending file
malformed JSON was reported before any dependent file was created
identity mismatch was reported before any dependent file was created
stale baseline was rejected and the newer shared record remained intact
unknown outcome and replay prohibition were retained

limits: The helpers are test fixtures, not a production checkpoint engine.
Passing deterministic invariants does not prove live agent or model behavior.
Native compaction, GUI new-session recovery, cross-host behavior and real external effects were not invoked.
